title: fix(cli): preserve raw Markdown when CLI documentation is piped
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: CLI documentation now applies Markdown styling only when stdout is a TTY. Piped or redirected human-mode output keeps raw Markdown, including inline-code backticks. A regression test covers non-TTY output, and @pollinations/cli is bumped to 0.1.34.
